deacon.description: An older African-American man in his sixties, a church deacon and father figure. Deep, warm, slightly gravelly baritone with a gentle Southern cadence. Speaks slowly and deliberately with weight and long pauses, like a late-night talk with his son. Studio-quality recording.

texan.description: A weathered white Texas rancher in his late fifties. Deep, low, unhurried Southern drawl, calm and grounded with a little gravel. Speaks slowly like an old cowboy giving hard-earned advice by a fire. Studio-quality recording.

mentor.description: An old-school wise mentor in his seventies with a neutral American accent. Very deep bass voice with natural vocal fry and gravitas, like an old movie narrator or grandfather storyteller. Slow, steady, hypnotic, measured pacing. Studio-quality recording.
